verdict.rationale: Sentry's documented AI capabilities cover agent tracing: conversation replay, LLM call comparison, dashboards for cost, tokens and tools, and trace views. Nothing in the evidence describes creating datasets, triggering eval runs, or retrieving eval results, whether programmatically or otherwise. Because an AI-observability platform could plausibly ship evals, the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create a dataset, trigger an eval run programmatically, and read back the results
